title: Straight Quote Converter
h1: Straight Quote Converter — Clean Curly Quotes
seoTitle: Straight Quote Converter — Clean Curly Quotes
description: Replace curly quotes, apostrophes, dashes and invisible spaces with plain ASCII characters. Helpful before pasting into code or CSV. Runs locally.
intro: Paste text copied from a document or web page. The converter turns smart quotes and dashes into straight characters and can strip zero-width spaces.
blurb: Turn curly quotes, dashes and invisible spaces into plain ASCII text.

controls.label: Also convert en and em dashes to hyphens

howItWorks: Paste text that may contain curly quotes from a word processor or website.
Choose whether dashes and invisible spaces should be normalized too.
Press Convert quotes. Left and right quotes become " and apostrophes become '.
examples: An em dash can be rewritten as a hyphen when that option is on.

faq.q: Why do curly quotes cause bugs?
faq.a: Code, CSV and some search tools expect ASCII quotes. A curly quote looks similar but is a different character, so strings and formulas fail to match.
No. Letters such as é stay as they are. Only quote, dash and selected invisible-space characters are rewritten.
